title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text: Text as a whole without the word ‘systematic’
part_context: Calls on the Commission to propose, by the end of Q1 2025, delegated and implementing acts to the MDR and the IVDR to address the most pressing challenges and bottlenecks in the implementation of the legislative frameworks and to propose the <del>systematic</del> revision of all relevant articles of these regulations, accompanied by an impact assessment, to be conducted as soon as possible;
